museum.blurb: DEC’s own UNIX on DEC’s own 64-bit iron. Born OSF/1 in 1992, renamed Digital UNIX and finally Tru64, this was the operating system the AlphaServer ES40 was designed around: a fully 64-bit UNIX with the CDE desktop, from the same company that built the processor under it. Version 5.1B of 2003 was the line’s last major release — HP retired Alpha and Tru64 together, and their engineering went on into HP-UX and beyond.
